metaDescription: Order custom with zipper school spirit items for your team. Perfect for bulk orders. Shop at Perfect Imprints today!
introHtml: Zippered school spirit items keep your logo secure and your gear organized. Whether you need custom zippered totes for a pep rally or branded pencil pouches for the PTA, the zipper closure adds functionality that open-top bags lack. Choose from nylon, polyester, or canvas options in your school colors, and add your mascot or logo with screen printing or embroidery. These items are built for daily use by students, staff, and fans.
